limitations: IBKR historical volume units are assumed to be shares; if your feed reports lots of 100, only the participation cap (not RVOL, a ratio) is affected.

periods_method: Chronological split of the trading days: the first 60% in-sample, the next 20% validation, the last 20% out-of-sample. Trades are assigned to the segment in which they exited. Walk-forward folds are consecutive equal blocks used to check whether results are consistent over time.
